answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a single drilled shale core held as a physical relic in an independent geology lab; the lab fires a random acoustic pulse through the core each month, and only the registered holder present live on video within minutes passes the check. Cores cannot be bought in bulk, and one lab tests one core per day, so each extra fake costs another real drilling fee in outside money doubling per core on the same funding trail, another lab day, and another live human.
